picked_rationale.C1: C1 is the load-bearing positive result of this project (subliminal transfer phenomenon existence, mean_gap=0.169, p=0.008, 6/7 seeds): it is the central scientific contribution that all downstream mechanism work depends on. A model-configuration swap on C1 provides the highest-value robustness information — it tests whether the behavioral phenomenon holds under a different LoRA configuration (rank or target), which is the most consequential open question for publication credibility. C2's refutation is already settled within the committed family (LoRA-SVD / additive-steering, two configurations tested); further swapping a refuted mechanism claim yields less novel information.
